BiblicalUsage: habhâb is a plain word for gift (in sacrifice), i.e. holocaust. In Hosea 8:13, the text says "They sacrifice flesh [for] the sacrifices of mine offerings."
TheologicalSignificance: I read habhâb plainly — it means gift,  holocaust, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
